cohort: 7 Korean women with Takayasu arteritis (12 pregnancies)
finding: Pregnant Korean women with TA had a 75% live birth rate, but experienced a high rate of pregnancy complications, including hypertension, preterm birth, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: 8 out of 9 live births were delivered by cesarean section.
gest_age: One neonate was born at 30 weeks of gestation.
birth_weight: Two out of nine neonates had low birth weight.
